title: Professional Host Tiers: Return-Charge Courtesy on Payout Methods
content:
**Courtesy term.** The return-charge courtesy share is applied to the return charge on a transfer returned to one of the host's Payout Methods, by the tier on the host's Host Accounts record: 0 percent of the return charge is charged to a Professional Host Plus or Enterprise Partner account, 50 percent to a Professional Host account, and the whole amount to any other tier.

## Courtesy share by host tier

| Host account tier | Part of the return charge charged to the account |
|---|---|
| Enterprise Partner | 0 percent |
| Professional Host Plus | 0 percent |
| Professional Host | 50 percent |
| Superhost | The whole amount |
| Standard Host | The whole amount |
| Starter Host | The whole amount |

## Application

- The share is applied to the return charge as worked out, with nothing rounded before it; the shared charge is then rounded half up to the cent.
- A shared charge of 0.00, as for every Professional Host Plus and Enterprise Partner account, is a return charge that works out to 0.00.

## Hypothetical illustrations

| Imagined account | Return charge as worked out | Charged to the account |
|---|---|---|
| Professional Host | USD 31.67 | 50 percent: USD 15.835, rounded half up to USD 15.84 |
| Enterprise Partner | USD 26.00 | 0 percent: USD 0.00 |
| Standard Host | USD 26.00 | The whole amount: USD 26.00 |
